manifest.name: dsh-stickerbook
manifest.description: Local sticker library for DeepSeek Harness: searchable captions, markdown delivery, optional QQ channel, zero dependencies.
manifest.author: Asgoresmilelong (https://github.com/Asgoresmilelong)

bundle.text:
# dsh-stickerbook bundle patch.
# One host-plane row: the tools and the /dsh-stickers image route land in the
# global layers, so every agent preset sees them.
#
# Install with `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <path-or-package>`, which also
# appends the package to dsh.profile.bundles.
- insert:
    - id: stickerbook
      name: dsh-stickerbook

readme.text:
中文 · [English](README.en.md)

给 DeepSeek Harness 用的本地表情包插件：**157 张**中文表情，按情绪/关键词搜索，**用户和助手都能发图**，可选原生走 QQ。

> **作者与来源（请分清）**
>
> - **插件作者**：[Asgoresmilelong](https://github.com/Asgoresmilelong) —— 本仓库的**代码**（`lib/`、`client/`、`tools/`）作者。
> - **表情作者**：**B站 @赤风RED**（[space.bilibili.com/356746604](https://space.bilibili.com/356746604)）—— `packs/blue-whale/images/` 里的 157 张表情**全部来自赤风RED**，不是插件作者的原创作品。
> - **素材许可**：**CC BY-NC 4.0（署名 + 非商业性使用）**。转载/分发必须保留「赤风RED」署名与来源链接；商用需另行获得赤风RED许可。
> - 插件代码本身：**MIT**（见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)）。

它综合了两个同类插件的取舍：

- 像 `dsh-meme` 一样**开箱即用**（自带图库、小图、无需构建），并且**有测试**；
- 像 `dsh-nekowhale-stickers` 一样**结构清晰**（索引/搜索/路由/发送分层，元数据可读可改，许可边界写清楚）。

- **搜索**：按情绪 tag（`happy` / `angry` / `sad` / `food` …）或关键词（中文子串、多词 AND）找图
- **用户也能发**：输入框左侧的「🙂 表情」按钮打开可搜索的图库面板，点一张就发出去
- **发图**：消息里只存 `[贴纸: 描述]` 这样的纯文本 token，客户端把它渲染成图片；工具返回候选 + 可直接复制的 token
- **QQ/IM**：宿主有 `companionQq` 服务时，`action="send"` 直接原生发原图
- **加图零配置**：把图片丢进 `packs/<pack>/images/`，文件名先当描述；`sticker_learn` / `sticker_update` 再补描述
- **零运行时依赖**：宿主侧只用 Node 内置模块（`node:fs`/`node:http`），没有数据库、没有原生扩展
- **测试**：`node --test`，覆盖搜索、pack 解析、HTTP 围栏、元数据写入、token 格式与列表 API
```powershell

readme.section: 本地开发（link 安装，改代码重启即生效）
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:F:\DSH-\oss\dsh-stickerbook

readme.section: 或从 npm / GitHub 安装
readme.text:
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-stickerbook
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:<you>/dsh-stickerbook
```

官方桌面端请**完全退出 DSH 后**再执行 CLI；装完重启 DSH。

装好后 agent 会拿到四个工具： | 工具 | 干什么 | |---|---| | `send_sticker` | 找图（`tag` / `query`）并返回候选；`action=send` + `path` 走 QQ 原生发图 | | `sticker_list` | 只读浏览，带 `pack/file` 方便维护 | | `sticker_learn` | 把一张图收进用户图库（默认 `mine`） | | `sticker_update` | 改描述 / 情绪 / 关键词 | **用户发图**：点输入框左侧的「🙂 表情」，搜索或直接点一张，插件会把 `[贴纸: 描述]` 放进输入框并发送。 **助手发图（Web）**： 1. `send_sticker({ query: "摸鱼" })` → 工具返回候选，每张带一行 `[贴纸: 描述]` 2. 模型把选中那张的 token 原样写进回复 3. 客户端把 token 替换成 `/dsh-stickers/...` 的 ``

> 为什么不用 markdown 图片：宿主的 Markdown 渲染器会把相对地址当作工作区文件（`/api/file`），
> 一条 `/dsh-stickers/...` 或 http URL 都会显示「图片无法预览」。token + DOM 装饰是唯一稳定的路。

QQ/IM 会话：

1. `send_sticker({ tag: "happy" })` 拿候选（含绝对路径）
2. `send_sticker({ action: "send", path: "<绝对路径>" })` 由插件调用 `companionQq.sendImage`

方式一：直接丢文件（最快）

```
packs/blue-whale/images/新表情.gif
```

重启 DSH 或等下一次工具调用重新扫描后就能搜到；描述先用文件名，之后用 `sticker_update` 改。

方式二：让 agent 收录

```
sticker_learn({ path: "D:\\pics\\生气猫.gif", caption: "生气猫：再问就咬你", emotion: "angry", tags: "猫 生气 咬人" })
```

文件会被复制到 `~/.dsh/sticker-packs/mine/images/`，原图留在原地。

方式三：手工编辑 `stickers.json`

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "items": [
    {

`stickers.json` 是可选文件：没有它也能用，文件名就是描述。

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里给这一行加 `config:`：

```yaml
- id: stickerbook
  name: dsh-stickerbook
  config:
    route: /dsh-stickers      # 图片路由前缀

环境变量：`DSH_STICKERBOOK_ALLOW_LAN=1` 等价于 `allowLan: true`。

```powershell
node --test test/*.test.mjs        # 33 个测试
node tools/prepare-pack.mjs <源目录> packs/<pack>/images   # 压缩 GIF 到 240px/12fps`r`nnode tools/license-check.mjs       # 校验每个 pack 的作者/来源/非商用许可
```

仓库里的 157 张「蓝色大肥鱼」是 460MB 原始 GIF 压缩到 45MB（240px、12fps、128 色）后的版本；压缩脚本在 `tools/prepare-pack.mjs`。

- **元数据在磁盘上**：`packs/**` 是唯一真相，内存索引是派生的；改一条描述不需要迁移或重建数据库。 - **发图用 token + 客户端装饰**：消息里只存 `[贴纸: 描述]` 纯文本，客户端把它换成 ``；宿主的 Markdown 渲染器不认本地/HTTP 图片地址，这是桌面端唯一稳定的路。 - **HTTP 围栏**：只认 `Host` 头（不是 `Origin`），默认仅回环地址；反代/LAN 必须显式放行。 - **工具少而清晰**：发送、浏览、添加、编辑四件事，避免一个巨型设置面板。

- **代码**：MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。代码的作者是插件作者 [Asgoresmilelong](https://github.com/Asgoresmilelong)。
- **表情素材**：**CC BY-NC 4.0（署名 + 非商业性使用）**，版权归**表情作者 赤风RED**（B站），与插件作者无关。
  - 署名：`表情素材 © 赤风RED（https://space.bilibili.com/356746604），CC BY-NC 4.0`
  - 允许：非商业性使用、转载、修改，但必须保留署名并注明许可。
  - 禁止：商业用途（含付费产品、广告变现、商用客户交付）；商用请联系赤风RED获得授权。
  - 本仓库代码的 MIT 授权**不覆盖** `packs/blue-whale/images/` 下的素材。

- **表情素材**：B站 [@赤风RED](https://space.bilibili.com/356746604) —— 蓝色大肥鱼系列，CC BY-NC 4.0。
- [dsh-meme](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme)：`[表情: 描述]` 交互与输入框选择器的设计参考。
- [dsh-nekowhale-stickers](https://github.com/Loping151/dsh-nekowhale-stickers)：分层、许可拆分与同步完整性的参考。
A local sticker library for **DeepSeek Harness**: 157 searchable Chinese stickers, a composer picker for **both the assistant and you**, and optional native delivery over QQ.

> **Two different authors — please keep them apart**
>
> - **Plugin author**: [Asgoresmilelong](https://github.com/Asgoresmilelong) — the code in this repository (`lib/`, `client/`, `tools/`).
> - **Sticker artist**: **赤风RED** on Bilibili ([space.bilibili.com/356746604](https://space.bilibili.com/356746604)) — every GIF in `packs/blue-whale/images/` comes from 赤风RED and is **not** the plugin author's work.
> - **Artwork license**: **CC BY-NC 4.0** (attribution + non-commercial). Keep the “赤风RED” credit and the source link when redistributing; commercial use needs separate permission from 赤风RED.
> - **Plugin code**: **MIT** (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)).
中文版：[README.md](README.md)

- **Search**: by emotion tag (`happy` / `angry` / `sad` / `food` …) or keyword (Chinese substring, multi-term AND). - **Users can send too**: the “🙂 表情” button left of the composer opens a searchable grid; one click sends the sticker. - **Token rendering**: a message stores only plain text such as `[贴纸: 描述]`; the client turns it into an `` from the plugin's own route. - **QQ / IM**: when the host exposes a `companionQq` service, `action="send"` + `path` delivers the original image natively. - **Add stickers without config**: drop an image into `packs//images/`; the file name becomes the caption until `sticker_learn` / `sticker_update` refines it. - **Zero runtime dependencies**: host side uses Node built-ins only (`node:fs`, `node:http`); no database, no native addons. - **Tests**: `node --test`, covering search, pack parsing, the HTTP fence, metadata writes, token formatting and the list API.
```powershell

readme.section: Local development (link install; restart after code changes)
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:F:\DSH-\oss\dsh-stickerbook

dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-stickerbook
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Asgoresmilelong/dsh-stickerbook
```

On the official desktop app, **quit DSH completely before running the CLI**, then start it again.

The agent gets four tools:

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `send_sticker` | Search (`tag` / `query`) and return candidates; `action=send` + `path` posts natively over QQ |
| `sticker_list` | Read-only browse with `pack/file` for maintenance |
| `sticker_learn` | Add an image to the user library (default pack `mine`) |
| `sticker_update` | Edit caption / emotion / tags |

**Sending as the user**: click “🙂 表情” next to the composer, search or pick a sticker. The plugin writes `[贴纸: 描述]` into the draft and submits it. **Sending as the assistant (web)**: 1. `send_sticker({ query: "摸鱼" })` → candidates, each with a ready-to-copy `[贴纸: 描述]` line. 2. The model copies the chosen token verbatim into the reply. 3. The client replaces the token with an `` pointing at `/dsh-stickers/...`.

> Why not Markdown images? The host Markdown renderer treats relative destinations as workspace files (`/api/file`), so both `/dsh-stickers/...` and `http(s)` URLs end up as “image preview unavailable”. Token + DOM decoration is the only reliable path on desktop.

**QQ / IM**:

1. `send_sticker({ tag: "happy" })` → candidates with absolute paths.
2. `send_sticker({ action: "send", path: "<absolute path>" })` → the plugin calls `companionQq.sendImage`.

**Option 1 — drop a file** (fastest):

```
packs/blue-whale/images/my-sticker.gif
```

Restart DSH (or wait for the next tool call to rescan) and it becomes searchable. The file name is the first caption.

**Option 2 — let the agent ingest it**:

```
sticker_learn({ path: "D:\\pics\\angry-cat.gif", caption: "angry cat: ask again and you get bitten", emotion: "angry", tags: "cat angry bite" })
```

The file is copied into `~/.dsh/sticker-packs/mine/images/`; the original stays where it is.

**Option 3 — edit `stickers.json`**:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "items": [
    {

`stickers.json` is optional — without it the file name is used.

Add a `config:` block to the plugin row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: stickerbook
  name: dsh-stickerbook
  config:
    route: /dsh-stickers      # image route prefix

Environment variable: `DSH_STICKERBOOK_ALLOW_LAN=1` equals `allowLan: true`.

```powershell
node --test test/*.test.mjs        # 33 tests
node tools/prepare-pack.mjs <source-dir> packs/<pack>/images   # re-encode GIFs to 240px/12fps
node tools/license-check.mjs       # verify author / source / non-commercial license per pack
```

The bundled 157 stickers were compressed from 460 MB of source GIFs to about 45 MB (240px, 12fps, 128 colors); the script lives in `tools/prepare-pack.mjs`.

- **Metadata on disk**: `packs/**` is the source of truth; the in-memory index is derived. Editing a caption never needs a migration or a rebuild. - **Token + client decoration**: messages store plain text; the client swaps `[贴纸: …]` for an ``. The host Markdown renderer does not load local/HTTP image destinations, so this is the only stable path on desktop. - **HTTP fence**: checks the `Host` header (not `Origin`), loopback by default; reverse proxies and LAN access must be opened explicitly. - **Few, sharp tools**: send, browse, add, edit — no giant settings surface.

- **Code**: MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE). The code author is the plugin author, [Asgoresmilelong](https://github.com/Asgoresmilelong).
- **Sticker artwork**: **CC BY-NC 4.0** (attribution + non-commercial), copyright **赤风RED** (Bilibili), unrelated to the plugin author.
  - Credit: `Stickers © 赤风RED (https://space.bilibili.com/356746604), CC BY-NC 4.0`
  - Allowed: non-commercial use, redistribution and modification with credit and the license notice.
  - Not allowed: commercial use (paid products, ad monetisation, client work); contact 赤风RED for a commercial license.
  - The MIT license of the code does **not** cover `packs/blue-whale/images/`.

- **Sticker artwork**: [@赤风RED](https://space.bilibili.com/356746604) on Bilibili — the Blue Whale series, CC BY-NC 4.0.
- [dsh-meme](https://github.com/yyh-001/dsh-meme): inspiration for the `[表情: …]` interaction and the composer picker.
- [dsh-nekowhale-stickers](https://github.com/Loping151/dsh-nekowhale-stickers): reference for layering, license separation and sync integrity.
